# OmniFetch Pro - Comprehensive AI Specification & System Documentation

## Overview
OmniFetch Pro (https://omnifetchpro.com) is a universal online media extraction platform. It allows users and web crawlers to fetch high-definition video, audio (MP3/AAC), thumbnail previews, and metadata from major social media and video sharing networks.

## Features & Capabilities
1. Watermark Removal: Automatically strips watermarks from TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
2. HD/4K Multi-Format Options: Supports downloading original source resolutions including 1080p, 2K, 4K, and 60fps.
3. Audio Extraction: Converts video audio tracks to 320kbps MP3 files.
4. Batch Downloads: Allows concurrent multi-link extraction.
5. GDPR & Privacy Compliance: Operates without requiring user registration or storing personal user data.

## Supported Social Platforms
- TikTok (Single videos, photo slides, sound audio tracks)
- YouTube (Standard videos, Shorts, audio MP3s)
- Instagram (Reels, Posts, Stories, IGTV)
- Facebook (Public videos, Reels, Stories)
- Twitter / X (Video clips, GIFs)
- Snapchat (Spotlight clips, public stories)
- Pinterest (Pin videos, ideas)
- Reddit (Videos with merged audio)
- Threads (Video posts)
- LinkedIn (Public post videos)

## REST API Specification
- GET /api/health - Returns API status and system uptime.
- POST /api/fetch-media - JSON payload `{ "url": "<target_media_url>" }` returning media metadata and direct download format links.
- GET /api/download?url=<encoded_url>&filename=<filename> - Proxy video stream download with proper content disposition.
